text:
morgan: quick check — /v1/generate structured outputs are showing `metadata: null` for some clients and completely omitted for others. Customer hit a crash. Is this an intentional change?

sam: which client/version? can you paste the failing response or a curl?

morgan: acme-web, client v1.2.3. repro curl + responses below:
```
curl -H 'Accept: application/json' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"x"}'
// older -> 
{
  \"choices\": [ { \"text\": \"ok\", \"metadata\": null } ]
}
// newer -> 
{
  \"choices\": [ { \"text\": \"ok\" } ]
}
```

irene: product here — if SDKs expect the key to exist, dropping it is a breaking change. we need to preserve stable shape for at least one release and communicate.

alex: platform policy generally prefers omitting optional keys instead of returning explicit `null` (less ambiguity), but i know SDK deserializers sometimes treat missing vs null differently. we need to pick a compatibility strategy, not flip-flop.

sandy: could add a response header or client-version routing, but that adds complexity. where is the canonical schema defined?

sam: schema lives in repo infra/api-contracts/openapi.yaml. current generator treats optional fields as nullable by default. i'll open a small PR to make `metadata` explicitly optional+absent by default and add a compatibility shim keyed by `X-Client-Version`. pinging @alex @sandy for API review.

qa-bot: regression failing: tests/response_shape/test_metadata_null.py (see CI logs)

deploy-bot: CI for #4321 — build failed on lint (flake8) — rerun?

sam: fixing lint now, will rerun.

alex: for rollout: propose we ship shim that keeps `metadata: null` if client-version < 1.3.0, otherwise omit. add changelog + deprecation note. do a 24h canary in us-west first.

irene: agreed. i'll draft a short customer notice and SDK note to be sent once we ship the shim and schedule deprecation timeline (2 releases).

morgan: thanks — can someone add a one-paragraph to api-contracts/README about nullable vs absent policy? i'd like a single source of truth.

sam: will do in the PR. PR link: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4321 (updates openapi, adds shim, tests). PTAL.

qa-bot: CI now passing on branch, tests green.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started to us-west (service: api-gateway)

morgan: awesome. marking this thread for follow-up after canary completes.

irene: thanks everyone — we'll track deprecation in release notes and notify customers. :thumbsup:
